snippet.title: Stars of Icarus | Playtest Announcement
snippet.description:
Sign up to the playtest on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2278950/starsoficarus/

In Stars of Icarus, you’ll assemble a squad of teammates, duking it out 5v5 as you vie for victory. Customize your loadout and choose from powerful Frigates, agile Fighters, and more to strategically form a squad capable of taking on any enemy team. 

https://www.starsoficarus.com
